description: Scrape reviews from a public Facebook business page by direct URL, business name search, or numeric Page ID, with optional date/keyword/recommendation filters.

cookies.description: Optional Facebook session cookies (from a logged-in browser) to unlock more reviews. Without cookies, Facebook limits results to ~10–15 per page. Use a browser extension like 'EditThisCookie' to export cookies as JSON. Each entry must have at minimum 'name', 'value', and 'domain' fields.
cookies.title: Facebook Cookies

filterByDateFrom.description: Only return reviews posted on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-01-01).
filterByDateFrom.title: Date From (YYYY-MM-DD)

filterByDateTo.description: Only return reviews posted on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-12-31).
filterByDateTo.title: Date To (YYYY-MM-DD)

filterByKeyword.description: Only return reviews containing this word or phrase (case-insensitive).
filterByKeyword.title: Keyword Filter

filterByRecommendation.description: Only return reviews with the selected recommendation status. Facebook uses binary Recommended/Not Recommended (no star ratings).
filterByRecommendation.title: Recommendation Filter

maxReviews.description: Maximum total reviews to scrape across all input pages (1–500). Collection stops once this global cap is reached.
maxReviews.title: Max Reviews (Global)

maxReviewsPerPage.description: Maximum reviews to scrape from each individual Facebook page (1–500). Useful when scraping multiple URLs to get an even spread of reviews per page.
maxReviewsPerPage.title: Max Reviews Per Page

mode.description: How to specify which Facebook page to scrape reviews from.
mode.title: Input Mode

pageIds.description: Numeric Facebook Page IDs (e.g. '123456789'). Used when mode is 'Facebook Page ID'.
pageIds.title: Facebook Page IDs

proxyCountry.description: Country to route the actor's residential proxy through (residential proxy is always used and is not configurable off — Facebook consistently blocks this actor's sessions without it). Facebook renders its UI text (including the Recommended/Not Recommended wording) based on the proxy's IP location, not just browser settings — a non-English-speaking exit country can break English-text-based extraction even though the review data itself is unaffected. Defaults to United States.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country

searchQueries.description: Business name and location to search for (e.g. 'Starbucks Dallas TX'). Used when mode is 'Business Name Search'. Facebook's own on-site search requires a login and is not used; results are resolved via an external web search instead, so accuracy depends on how distinctive the name/location is — for a guaranteed exact match, use 'Direct URL' or 'Facebook Page ID' mode instead.
searchQueries.title: Business Search Queries

sortBy.description: Order in which to load reviews from the page. Note: Facebook's current review pages do not consistently expose a visible sort control — 'Most Helpful' is attempted on a best-effort basis and silently falls back to the page's default order when unavailable.
sortBy.title: Sort Order

startUrls.description: Links to Facebook page review sections (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/mcdonalds/reviews). Used when mode is 'Direct URL'.
startUrls.title: Facebook Reviews URLs

title: Facebook Reviews Scraper Input
